# Agent: Agent Mode, Date: 2025-08-16, Observation: Initial CMake build config for libasyncinput and examples
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.13)
project(asyncinput C)

set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 11)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)

# Options
option(ASYNCINPUT_BUILD_SHARED "Build shared library" ON)
option(ASYNCINPUT_BUILD_STATIC "Build static library" ON)
option(ASYNCINPUT_BUILD_EXAMPLES "Build example programs" OFF)
option(ASYNCINPUT_EXPERIMENTAL_BACKENDS "Enable experimental exotic OS backends" ON)
option(ASYNCINPUT_NO_SDL "Disable all SDL usage (no SDL2 stub, no SDL3 examples)" OFF)
set(CMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS ON)
# Include dirs
include_directories(${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include)

# Backend selection
# Priority: forced-backend (if set) -> native (Linux/Windows/Haiku/KasperskyOS/Phantom) -> SDL2 stub (if available) -> software-input fallback
set(ASYNCINPUT_SRC "")
set(ASYNCINPUT_USE_SDL2_STUB FALSE)
set(ASYNCINPUT_USE_SOFT_INPUT FALSE)
set(ASYNCINPUT_BACKEND_NAME "")
set(ASYNCINPUT_BACKEND_DEFS "")

# Allow forcing a backend for cross-compilation without a real toolchain
# Values: linux, win, haiku, kasperskyos, phantom, sdl2-stub, soft
set(ASYNCINPUT_FORCE_BACKEND "" CACHE STRING "Force a specific backend (for cross-compiling)")

string(TOLOWER "${ASYNCINPUT_FORCE_BACKEND}" _FORCE_B)
if(NOT _FORCE_B STREQUAL "")
    if(_FORCE_B STREQUAL "win" OR _FORCE_B STREQUAL "windows")
        set(ASYNCINPUT_SRC src/libasyncinput_win.c)
        set(ASYNCINPUT_BACKEND_NAME "win")
    elseif(_FORCE_B STREQUAL "linux")
        set(ASYNCINPUT_SRC src/libasyncinput_posix.c)
        set(ASYNCINPUT_BACKEND_NAME "linux")
    elseif(_FORCE_B STREQUAL "haiku")
        set(ASYNCINPUT_SRC src/libasyncinput_haiku.c)
        list(APPEND ASYNCINPUT_BACKEND_DEFS ASYNCINPUT_FORCE_HAIKU=1)
        set(ASYNCINPUT_BACKEND_NAME "haiku-forced")
    elseif(_FORCE_B STREQUAL "kasperskyos")
        set(ASYNCINPUT_SRC src/libasyncinput_kasperskyos.c)
        list(APPEND ASYNCINPUT_BACKEND_DEFS KASPERSKYOS=1)
        set(ASYNCINPUT_BACKEND_NAME "kasperskyos-forced")
elseif(_FORCE_B STREQUAL "phantom")
        set(ASYNCINPUT_SRC src/libasyncinput_phantom.c)
        list(APPEND ASYNCINPUT_BACKEND_DEFS PHANTOMOS=1)
        set(ASYNCINPUT_BACKEND_NAME "phantom-forced")
    elseif(_FORCE_B STREQUAL "kolibrios")
        set(ASYNCINPUT_SRC src/libasyncinput_kolibrios.c)
        list(APPEND ASYNCINPUT_BACKEND_DEFS KOLIBRIOS=1)
        set(ASYNCINPUT_BACKEND_NAME "kolibrios-forced")
    elseif(_FORCE_B STREQUAL "openbsd" OR _FORCE_B STREQUAL "freebsd")
        if(ASYNCINPUT_NO_SDL)
            set(ASYNCINPUT_SRC src/libasyncinput_soft.c)
            set(ASYNCINPUT_USE_SOFT_INPUT TRUE)
            set(ASYNCINPUT_BACKEND_NAME "${_FORCE_B}-soft-forced")
        else()
            set(ASYNCINPUT_SRC src/libasyncinput_stub.c)
            set(ASYNCINPUT_USE_SDL2_STUB TRUE)
            set(ASYNCINPUT_BACKEND_NAME "${_FORCE_B}-sdl2-stub-forced")
        endif()
    elseif(_FORCE_B STREQUAL "sdl2-stub")
        set(ASYNCINPUT_SRC src/libasyncinput_stub.c)
        set(ASYNCINPUT_USE_SDL2_STUB TRUE)
        set(ASYNCINPUT_BACKEND_NAME "sdl2-stub-forced")
    elseif(_FORCE_B STREQUAL "soft")
        set(ASYNCINPUT_SRC src/libasyncinput_soft.c)
        set(ASYNCINPUT_USE_SOFT_INPUT TRUE)
        set(ASYNCINPUT_BACKEND_NAME "soft-forced")
    endif()
endif()

if(ASYNCINPUT_SRC STREQUAL "")
    if(WIN32)
        set(ASYNCINPUT_SRC src/libasyncinput_win.c)
        set(ASYNCINPUT_BACKEND_NAME "win")
    elseif(CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL "Linux")
        set(ASYNCINPUT_SRC src/libasyncinput_posix.c)
        set(ASYNCINPUT_BACKEND_NAME "linux")
    elseif(APPLE OR CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL "Darwin")
        # macOS: native IOHID backend (no SDL required)
        set(ASYNCINPUT_SRC src/libasyncinput_macos.c)
        set(ASYNCINPUT_BACKEND_NAME "macos")
    elseif(CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL "Haiku")
        if(ASYNCINPUT_EXPERIMENTAL_BACKENDS)
            set(ASYNCINPUT_SRC src/libasyncinput_haiku.c)
            set(ASYNCINPUT_BACKEND_NAME "haiku")
        endif()
elseif(CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL "KasperskyOS" OR DEFINED KASPERSKYOS)
        set(ASYNCINPUT_SRC src/libasyncinput_kasperskyos.c)
        set(ASYNCINPUT_BACKEND_NAME "kasperskyos")
    elseif(CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL "Phantom" OR DEFINED PHANTOMOS)
        set(ASYNCINPUT_SRC src/libasyncinput_phantom.c)
        set(ASYNCINPUT_BACKEND_NAME "phantom")
    elseif(CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL "KolibriOS" OR DEFINED KOLIBRIOS)
        set(ASYNCINPUT_SRC src/libasyncinput_kolibrios.c)
        set(ASYNCINPUT_BACKEND_NAME "kolibrios")
    endif()
endif()

# If the stub source is explicitly selected, make sure the stub define is set for TUs.
if(ASYNCINPUT_SRC STREQUAL "src/libasyncinput_stub.c")
    set(ASYNCINPUT_USE_SDL2_STUB TRUE)
    # Also add to backend defines to ensure it's passed to the targets
    list(APPEND ASYNCINPUT_BACKEND_DEFS ASYNCINPUT_STUB_SDL2=1)
endif()

# If still empty, try SDL2 stub (unless disabled), otherwise software-input backend
if(ASYNCINPUT_SRC STREQUAL "")
    if(NOT ASYNCINPUT_NO_SDL)
        find_package(SDL2 QUIET)
    endif()
    if(NOT ASYNCINPUT_NO_SDL AND SDL2_FOUND)
        set(ASYNCINPUT_SRC src/libasyncinput_stub.c)
        set(ASYNCINPUT_USE_SDL2_STUB TRUE)
        list(APPEND ASYNCINPUT_BACKEND_DEFS ASYNCINPUT_STUB_SDL2=1)
        set(ASYNCINPUT_BACKEND_NAME "sdl2-stub")
    else()
        set(ASYNCINPUT_SRC src/libasyncinput_soft.c)
        set(ASYNCINPUT_USE_SOFT_INPUT TRUE)
        set(ASYNCINPUT_BACKEND_NAME "soft")
    endif()
endif()

# Ensure SDL2 is available when stub backend is selected via force or detection
if((ASYNCINPUT_USE_SDL2_STUB OR ASYNCINPUT_NEEDS_SDL2) AND NOT ASYNCINPUT_NO_SDL)
    find_package(SDL2 QUIET)
    if(NOT SDL2_FOUND)
        message(FATAL_ERROR "SDL2 is required for the selected stub backend, but it was not found. Install SDL2 development files or select a different backend, or set ASYNCINPUT_NO_SDL=ON.")
    endif()
endif()


# Libraries
find_package(Threads REQUIRED)
find_package(PkgConfig QUIET)
if(PkgConfig_FOUND)
    pkg_check_modules(XKBCOMMON QUIET IMPORTED_TARGET xkbcommon)
endif()

if(ASYNCINPUT_BUILD_SHARED)
    add_library(asyncinput_shared SHARED ${ASYNCINPUT_SRC})
    target_link_libraries(asyncinput_shared PRIVATE Threads::Threads)
    if (XKBCOMMON_FOUND)
        target_link_libraries(asyncinput_shared PRIVATE PkgConfig::XKBCOMMON)
        target_compile_definitions(asyncinput_shared PRIVATE ASYNCINPUT_HAVE_XKBCOMMON=1)
    endif()
    if(APPLE)
        # Link macOS frameworks for IOHIDManager backend
        target_link_libraries(asyncinput_shared PRIVATE "-framework IOKit" "-framework CoreFoundation")
    endif()
if(ASYNCINPUT_USE_SDL2_STUB)
        target_compile_definitions(asyncinput_shared PUBLIC ASYNCINPUT_STUB_SDL2=1)
        if(SDL2_FOUND)
            target_link_libraries(asyncinput_shared PUBLIC SDL2::SDL2)
        elseif(TARGET SDL2::SDL2-static)
            target_link_libraries(asyncinput_shared PUBLIC SDL2::SDL2-static)
        else()
            # Fallback: try to find SDL2 manually
            target_link_libraries(asyncinput_shared PUBLIC SDL2)
        endif()
    endif()
    if(ASYNCINPUT_USE_SOFT_INPUT)
        target_compile_definitions(asyncinput_shared PRIVATE ASYNCINPUT_HAVE_SOFTINPUT=1)
    endif()
    if(NOT "${ASYNCINPUT_BACKEND_DEFS}" STREQUAL "")
        target_compile_definitions(asyncinput_shared PRIVATE ${ASYNCINPUT_BACKEND_DEFS})
    endif()
    set_target_properties(asyncinput_shared PROPERTIES OUTPUT_NAME asyncinput)
endif()

if(ASYNCINPUT_BUILD_STATIC)
    add_library(asyncinput_static STATIC ${ASYNCINPUT_SRC})
    target_link_libraries(asyncinput_static PRIVATE Threads::Threads)
    if (XKBCOMMON_FOUND)
        target_link_libraries(asyncinput_static PRIVATE PkgConfig::XKBCOMMON)
        target_compile_definitions(asyncinput_static PRIVATE ASYNCINPUT_HAVE_XKBCOMMON=1)
    endif()
    if(APPLE)
        # Link macOS frameworks for IOHIDManager backend
        target_link_libraries(asyncinput_static PRIVATE "-framework IOKit" "-framework CoreFoundation")
    endif()
if(ASYNCINPUT_USE_SDL2_STUB)
        target_compile_definitions(asyncinput_static PUBLIC ASYNCINPUT_STUB_SDL2=1)
        if(SDL2_FOUND)
            target_link_libraries(asyncinput_static PUBLIC SDL2::SDL2)
        elseif(TARGET SDL2::SDL2-static)
            target_link_libraries(asyncinput_static PUBLIC SDL2::SDL2-static)
        else()
            # Fallback: try to find SDL2 manually
            target_link_libraries(asyncinput_static PUBLIC SDL2)
        endif()
    endif()
    if(ASYNCINPUT_USE_SOFT_INPUT)
        target_compile_definitions(asyncinput_static PRIVATE ASYNCINPUT_HAVE_SOFTINPUT=1)
    endif()
    if(NOT "${ASYNCINPUT_BACKEND_DEFS}" STREQUAL "")
        target_compile_definitions(asyncinput_static PRIVATE ${ASYNCINPUT_BACKEND_DEFS})
    endif()
    set_target_properties(asyncinput_static PROPERTIES OUTPUT_NAME asyncinput)
endif()

# Examples
if(ASYNCINPUT_BUILD_EXAMPLES)
    # Always portable examples
    add_executable(read_keys examples/read_keys.c)
    if(ASYNCINPUT_BUILD_SHARED)
        target_link_libraries(read_keys PRIVATE asyncinput_shared)
    else()
        target_link_libraries(read_keys PRIVATE asyncinput_static)
    endif()

    add_executable(mouse_demo examples/mouse_demo.c)
    if(ASYNCINPUT_BUILD_SHARED)
        target_link_libraries(mouse_demo PRIVATE asyncinput_shared Threads::Threads)
    else()
        target_link_libraries(mouse_demo PRIVATE asyncinput_static Threads::Threads)
    endif()

    add_executable(device_specific_demo examples/device_specific_demo.c)
    if(ASYNCINPUT_BUILD_SHARED)
        target_link_libraries(device_specific_demo PRIVATE asyncinput_shared)
    else()
        target_link_libraries(device_specific_demo PRIVATE asyncinput_static)
    endif()

    # Linux-only examples that use linux headers or uinput
    if(CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL "Linux")
        add_executable(callback_demo examples/callback_demo.c)
        if(ASYNCINPUT_BUILD_SHARED)
            target_link_libraries(callback_demo PRIVATE asyncinput_shared)
        else()
            target_link_libraries(callback_demo PRIVATE asyncinput_static)
        endif()

        add_executable(benchmark_asyncinput examples/benchmark_asyncinput.c)
        if(ASYNCINPUT_BUILD_SHARED)
            target_link_libraries(benchmark_asyncinput PRIVATE asyncinput_shared Threads::Threads)
        else()
            target_link_libraries(benchmark_asyncinput PRIVATE asyncinput_static Threads::Threads)
        endif()

        add_executable(hotplug_mouse_wait examples/hotplug_mouse_wait.c)
        if(ASYNCINPUT_BUILD_SHARED)
            target_link_libraries(hotplug_mouse_wait PRIVATE asyncinput_shared Threads::Threads)
        else()
            target_link_libraries(hotplug_mouse_wait PRIVATE asyncinput_static Threads::Threads)
        endif()
    else()
        message(STATUS "Skipping Linux-only examples (callback_demo, benchmark_asyncinput, hotplug_mouse_wait) on ${CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME}")
    endif()

    # SDL3-based examples: build only on platforms with SDL3 available.
    # KolibriOS and macOS: skip SDL3 examples explicitly.
    if(APPLE OR DEFINED KOLIBRIOS OR CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL "KolibriOS" OR ASYNCINPUT_NO_SDL)
        message(STATUS "Skipping SDL3 examples on this platform or SDL disabled")
    else()
        find_package(SDL3 QUIET)
        if(SDL3_FOUND)
            add_executable(sdl3_demo examples/sdl3_demo.c)
            target_link_libraries(sdl3_demo PRIVATE SDL3::SDL3 Threads::Threads)

            add_executable(sdl3_asyncinput examples/sdl3_asyncinput.c)
            if(ASYNCINPUT_BUILD_SHARED)
                target_link_libraries(sdl3_asyncinput PRIVATE SDL3::SDL3 asyncinput_shared Threads::Threads)
            else()
                target_link_libraries(sdl3_asyncinput PRIVATE SDL3::SDL3 asyncinput_static Threads::Threads)
            endif()
        else()
            message(STATUS "SDL3 not found; sdl3_demo and sdl3_asyncinput will not be built")
        endif()
    endif()
endif()

# Tests (simple smoke test)
include(CTest)
if(BUILD_TESTING)
    if(CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL "Linux")
        add_executable(asyncinput_smoke tests/smoke.c)
        if(ASYNCINPUT_BUILD_SHARED)
            target_link_libraries(asyncinput_smoke PRIVATE asyncinput_shared Threads::Threads)
        else()
            target_link_libraries(asyncinput_smoke PRIVATE asyncinput_static Threads::Threads)
        endif()
        add_test(NAME smoke COMMAND asyncinput_smoke)
    else()
        message(STATUS "Skipping tests on ${CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME}")
    endif()
endif()
